query: Enabling cfg_zero_star + use_zero_init (zero_star_steps=0 default) on WanVideoExperimentalArgs crashes on step 0: predict_with_cfg's early-exit branch returns a 2-tuple while all callers unpack 3 values (ValueError) — reproduces on any I2V/T2V graph, v1 and v2 samplers.

desired.outcome: OP fully root-caused it: the use_cfg_zero_star + use_zero_init early-exit in predict_with_cfg (nodes_sampler.py ~line 1172 on main) returns 2 values; fix is returning the 3-tuple from that branch. No maintainer reply, no merged fix at thread end.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
